assay_run.assay_type: Alizarin Red S staining and absorbance quantification
assay_run.method: Study-level comparison aggregate; this row represents the selected preparation groups rather than an individually identified acquisition. PFA-fixed osteogenic cultures stained with 2% Alizarin Red S. Dye was extracted using 10% acetic acid/20% methanol, followed by absorbance measurement at 450 nm (Figure 4a–b). For each anatomical origin, the BMP-2-treated staining intensity was normalized to the matched no-BMP-2 control. Multiple sample IDs preserve group associations and do not establish physical pooling.
